caption: Our medical aid claims back about half of what the therapy costs. Does yours cover the thing you actually need?

slides.title:
What our son's
therapy costs on
R44 500 p/m
Living in Howick
slides.body:
Him 40, her 37
Married, one son (7) in weekly therapy
Jobs: Dairy farm manager & remedial teacher
Household net income: R44 500 p/m

slides.title: Bond
slides.body: We bought before the therapy bills. We could not buy this house now.

slides.title: Medical aid
slides.body: Therapy sits outside the plan more than we expected, so this isn't the whole medical number.

slides.title: Therapy
slides.includes: Occupational and speech therapy, three sessions a week, after claims
slides.body: Before claims it's nearer R9 000. We stopped adding it up the first month.

slides.title: Groceries
slides.includes: Checkers, farm shop for milk and eggs
slides.body: He eats the same six foods. Waste is low, price is not.

slides.title: School
slides.body: The school is 18 km away. The right one cost more than the closest one.

slides.title: Everything else
slides.includes: Petrol, electricity, phones & fibre, car insurance, black tax, funeral policies, stokvel, takeaways
slides.body: Takeaways on therapy nights are R2 100. I'm not proud of it, we're simply too tired to cook by six.

slides.title: What's left
slides.body: Out of R44 500. It looks comfortable until the therapy invoice we only claim back in March.

slides.title: I stopped guessing
slides.body:
I uploaded our statements to Beyond Horizon and it totalled every therapy payment in one place.

We had been guessing R5 000.

No bank login needed.
